verdict.rationale: HelixDB is a graph/vector/text database. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools is an agent or MCP-client role, which is a category error for a database. The evidence shows HelixDB only acting as an MCP server (a Helix Cloud MCP endpoint exposing query tools). `helix chef` installs a docs MCP for the user's coding agent, which is not HelixDB itself consuming MCP tools, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
